transport_contract.limits: Two independent <=1024-byte stream captures. Each lifecycle record<=PIPE_BUF, emitted by existing bounded write_all. Separate records avoid exceeding4096bytes with two full hex streams.
transport_contract.publication_failure: Any lifecycle publication failure marks payload.fault before ND_PAYLOAD publication. Partial/missing lifecycle records are invalid input for future host oracle.
transport_contract.existing_schema: ND_PAYLOAD and its original byte/exit oracle remain unchanged.
host_review_boundary: No host lifecycle parser/manifest/runner change is included or activated. New marker contract requires independent review before use.

Host must require exactly one complete lifecycle status record, exactly one stdout stream and one stderr stream, correct ordering, complete untruncated EOF streams, no helper fault/timeout/setup error, clean reap and raw waitstatus0.

Host must decode probe stdout and independently validate exact before/status, shutdown return/errno, after NotBooted0, close, and final PASS record; require empty helper stderr as appropriate to frozen probe.
Host must independently apply unchanged payload oracle and ordinary diagnostic error scanning, transport limits and QEMU retirement requirements.
Local gate checks successful complete payload transport/status, not payload stdout bytes or application correctness.
The broader native_shutdown_observer snapshot protocol remains separate and is not fulfilled by these limited records.
